name: Problems
overview: Scripture reveals that God is our refuge and strength amid troubles, encouraging believers to trust Him wholeheartedly rather than relying on their own understanding. Challenges such as family, financial, and marital problems require wisdom, careful planning, and compassionate correction among believers. A kind word can uplift a heavy heart, and Christ calls His followers to be both wise and gentle as they navigate difficulties, exemplifying love and prudence in all relationships.
